sentences.text: This animal possessed broad, ridge-ornamented crushing teeth made of various dentine types.
The type species Campodus agassizianus was first described in 1844 from teeth found in the Namurian stage of Belgium.

There is a debate over whether Agassizodus, a related genus of extinct cartilaginous fish, and Campodus are synonyms, as some authors suggest they are the same while others note a lack of overlapping fossil locations.
